items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Unauthenticated Account Takeover
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges without requiring administrator access. Indications suggest active exploitation in the wild.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security-Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass without requiring authentication or administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: This high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could lead to arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce B2B leading to Security-Feature Bypass
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability specifically affecting Adobe Commerce B2B could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security-Feature Bypass
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A low-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability could result in privilege escalation, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution. This vulnerability has been actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Auth Bypass) Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization flaw in Adobe Commerce enables remote, unauthenticated attackers to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access to the application. Exploitation requires no user interaction and can be performed over the network.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload via REST API
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API, named 'PolyShell', allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store by disguising code as an image. Adobe released a fix in Magento 2.4.9 on May 12, 2026, but older supported versions remained vulnerable.
